title: mimi-content: CDDL oracle spike (T7)
description: Spike cddl =0.10.7 against mimi-content.cddl; validate fixtures and encoder output. Fallback: Ruby cddl script.
notes: Spike 2026-10-17: cddl =0.10.7 (MIT; needs features cbor,json,additional-controls,ast-span to compile) validates all 14 WG fixtures and implied-original, and correctly rejects 12 single-rule negatives, BUT wrongly rejects every unknown extension key (map entry with a choice key type: name = int / tstr .size (1..255)), so T6 fails. Not usable. Nothing committed. Recommended: Ruby cddl gem via a committed script run outside cargo test (gem not installed; ruby present; needs Mark's OK for gem install --user-install). Vendored CDDL in tests/fixtures/wg-09 already matches upstream and follows decisions .2.15/.2.16.
